span.p:
Lollipop = interface the class provides; IEmailService and
IAgentService declare exactly the public operations listed.
ProcessLeadAsync returns Status Fallback when Gemini:ApiKey is empty
or the call fails; LeadsController then saves the lead as NeedsReview.
SendAccountConfirmationEmailAsync is never called.
CaseManagementService is registered and unit tested,
but no controller calls it.
ApplicationDbContext uses Npgsql (PostgreSQL). OnModelCreating sets
keys, required fields, foreign keys and delete rules.
